properties.description: FunctionApp data connector with template version 3.0.0

connectorUiConfig.title: Function App Sample (Ingestion API)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The **Function App Sample** data connector demonstrates how to ingest custom JSON events into a Microsoft Sentinel custom table using an Azure Function and the [Azure Monitor Ingestion API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview) (DCE/DCR). Use this as a starting template for building your own Azure Function–based connectors.

sampleQueries.query:
FunctionAppSample_CL
| where EventType == "Alert"
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: FunctionAppSample_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
FunctionAppSample_CL
            | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
            | where isnotempty(Time)

value:
FunctionAppSample_CL
            | summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
            | project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(1d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and write permissions on the workspace are required.

customs.name: Microsoft.Web/sites permissions
customs.description: Read and write permissions to Azure Functions to create a Function App is required. [See the documentation to learn more about Azure Functions](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/).

customs.name: Azure AD App Registration
customs.description: An Azure AD App Registration (service principal) with the **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** role assigned on the Data Collection Rule (DCR) is required. [Learn more](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview#authentication).

customs.name: Data Collection Endpoint (DCE)
customs.description: A Data Collection Endpoint must be created in Azure Monitor. [Learn how to create a DCE](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/essentials/data-collection-endpoint-overview).

customs.name: Data Collection Rule (DCR)
customs.description: A Data Collection Rule that targets a custom Log Analytics table (e.g. FunctionAppSample_CL) must be created and associated with the DCE. [Learn how to create a DCR for custom logs](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/tutorial-logs-ingestion-portal).

instructionSteps.description: >**NOTE:** This connector uses Azure Functions and the Azure Monitor Ingestion API (DCE/DCR) to push sample events into Microsoft Sentinel. This might result in additional data ingestion costs. Check the [Azure Functions pricing page](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/functions/) and [Azure Monitor pricing page](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/monitor/) for details.

>**(Optional Step)** Securely store your App Registration credentials in Azure Key Vault. [Follow these instructions](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/app-service/app-service-key-vault-references) to use Azure Key Vault references with an Azure Function App.

1. In the [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com), navigate to **Azure Active Directory > App registrations > New registration**.
2. Provide a name (e.g. `FunctionApp-Sentinel-Connector`) and register.
3. Under **Certificates & secrets**, create a new client secret and note the **Tenant ID**, **Client ID**, and **Client Secret**.
instructionSteps.title: STEP 1 – Create an Azure AD App Registration

instructionSteps.description:
1. In the Azure Portal, navigate to **Monitor > Data Collection Endpoints > Create**.
2. Select your Subscription, Resource Group, and Region.
3. After creation, note the **Logs Ingestion** endpoint URL.
instructionSteps.title: STEP 2 – Create a Data Collection Endpoint (DCE)

instructionSteps.description:
1. In the Azure Portal, navigate to **Monitor > Data Collection Rules > Create**.
2. On the **Basics** tab, select your Subscription, Resource Group, Region, and select **Data Collection Endpoint** created in Step 2.
3. On the **Data sources** tab, add a custom JSON data source. Define the schema to match the sample connector fields (TimeGenerated, EventType, Message, Severity, Source, Category, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, SrcPort, DstPort, Action, CustomField1, CustomField2).
4. On the **Destination** tab, select **Azure Monitor Logs** and choose your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. Set the table to `FunctionAppSample_CL`.
5. After creation, note the DCR **immutableId** (format: `dcr-xxxxxxxx`) and the **stream name** (e.g. `Custom-FunctionAppSample_CL`).
6. Assign the **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** role to your App Registration on this DCR.
instructionSteps.title: STEP 3 – Create a Custom Table and Data Collection Rule (DCR)

instructionSteps.description:
**Option A – ARM Template (recommended)**

Click the **Deploy to Azure** button and fill in the parameters:

[![Deploy To Azure](https://aka.ms/deploytoazurebutton)](https://portal.azure.com/#create/Microsoft.Template/uri/https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Frobertmoriarty12%2FAzure-Sentinel%2Fmaster%2FSolutions%2FFunctionApp%2FData%2520Connectors%2Fazuredeploy_FunctionApp_API_FunctionApp.json)

**Option B – Manual Deployment**

1. Download or clone the Function App source from the solution package.
2. Follow the [Function App manual deployment instructions](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/blob/master/DataConnectors/AzureFunctionsManualDeployment.md) to deploy using Visual Studio Code.
3. After deployment, configure the Application Settings as described in Step 5.
instructionSteps.title: STEP 4 – Deploy the Azure Function App

instructionSteps.description:
In the Function App, navigate to **Configuration > Application settings** and add the following settings:

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| `TENANT_ID` | Your Azure AD Tenant ID |
| `CLIENT_ID` | Your App Registration Client ID |
| `CLIENT_SECRET` | Your App Registration Client Secret |
| `DCE_ENDPOINT` | Your Data Collection Endpoint URL |
| `DCR_ID` | Your DCR immutableId (e.g. `dcr-xxxxxxxx`) |
| `STREAM_NAME` | Stream name from DCR (e.g. `Custom-FunctionAppSample_CL`) |
instructionSteps.title: STEP 5 – Configure the Function App Application Settings

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The Function App Sample solution demonstrates how to ingest custom JSON events into a Microsoft Sentinel custom table using an Azure Function and the Azure Monitor Ingestion API (DCE/DCR). Use this as a starting template for building your own Azure Function–based data connectors.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

  1. Azure Monitor Ingestion API (DCE/DCR)

  2. Azure Functions

Data Connectors: 1

Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel | Learn more about Solutions
